description: This file implements functions for handling and manipulating file stat data, including filling, comparing, and validating file metadata in the context of a version control system or similar project.

methods.name: unsigned int munge_st_size(off_t st_size)
methods.description: Munges a file size value into an unsigned int, with special handling for exact 4 GiB multiples to avoid race conditions.

methods.name: void fill_stat_data(struct stat_data * sd,struct stat * st)
methods.description: Fills a custom stat_data structure with information from a standard stat structure.

methods.name: void set_times(struct stat * st,const struct stat_data * sd)
methods.description: Sets the times in a struct stat based on a stat_data structure, handling various timestamp formats.

methods.name: void fake_lstat_data(const struct stat_data * sd,struct stat * st)
methods.description: Fakes or reconstructs a struct stat from a stat_data structure for testing or internal use.

methods.name: int match_stat_data(const struct stat_data * sd,struct stat * st)
methods.description: Compares stat_data with a struct stat to detect changes in file metadata.

methods.name: void stat_validity_clear(struct stat_validity * sv)
methods.description: Clears the stored stat data in a stat_validity structure.

methods.name: int stat_validity_check(struct stat_validity * sv,const char * path)
methods.description: Checks if the stored stat data in a stat_validity structure matches the current file state.

methods.name: void stat_validity_update(struct stat_validity * sv,int fd)
methods.description: Updates the stored stat data in a stat_validity structure from the current file state.

ctags.name: set_times
ctags.pattern: /^static void set_times(struct stat *st, const struct stat_data *sd)$/
